scope: Local reviewer duplicate-run suppression and CR finding-number allocation
rule: Count a review-run marker or prior CR finding number only when it was authored by the installed GitHub App identity resolved and verified by numeric user ID. User-supplied lookalike text must not suppress a reviewer run or influence numbering.
rationale: PR #7 demonstrated that marker text and CR identifiers are attacker-copyable data, while their verified App authorship is the durable authority boundary. Merge f22c7241d2884108d5321dde0f94d00ceea317c8 added identity checks and regression coverage for both consumers.

origin.note: PR #7 CR-006 identified that unauthenticated marker and finding-ID text could suppress a run or alter subsequent numbering.
The owner confirmed the finding was fixed by resolving the App bot identity and requiring its numeric user ID for duplicate markers and historical CR numbers.
